arena: [생존기] Fiery Brand brands you and the enemy, reducing damage you take by 40%. Pop it when the enemy's burst cooldowns are focused on you.
[생존기] Metamorphosis increases current health by 40% for 15 sec, healing you for that amount, and increases Armor by 200%. Press it when your health has taken a big hit.
[차단] Disrupt interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec, and Sigil of Silence silences all enemies in the area after 2 sec. Split the two across the enemy healer's heal casts.

[제어] Sigil of Misery disorients enemies in the area with fear for 15 sec after 2 sec. With Lay In Wait it has 2 charges and waits in place for up to 90 sec until an enemy approaches, so pre-place it on the path to your healer.

[제어] Imprison incapacitates the target but damage can break it; with Detainment it lasts 1 sec longer and the target is immune to damage and healing while trapped. Use it on the enemy healer while your team isn't bursting.
[분담] Darkness gives allies within 8 yds a chance to avoid attack damage for 8 sec, doubled outside of raids. Stand in it with your team when enemy burst is focused.
[해제] Consume Magic devours and removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy. Strip an enemy DPS's burst buff or protective magic.
[위치] Vengeful Retreat removes all slows and leaps you backward, and Infernal Strike leaps you to a spot within 30 yds. Use them when you're slowed or need to get behind a pillar.
bg: [참고] In Battleground Blitz there are 0-1 tanks, and slow tanks need help carrying the flag. Create your own distance with Infernal Strike's leap and Vengeful Retreat's slow removal.
[제어] Illidan's Grasp stuns a target within 15 yds for 5 sec while you move it, and pressing it again throws it to a spot within 20 yds. Move the enemy flag carrier or base capper toward your team.

[제어] With Lay In Wait, Sigil of Misery waits up to 90 sec until an enemy approaches. Place it on the base flag you're guarding or the flag room entrance, and coordinate with your team's knockbacks since feared enemies can't be knocked back.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than relying on heals, keep Demon Spikes armor and Fiery Brand damage reduction chained without gaps.
[참고] Spectral Sight reveals stealthed and invisible enemies, and enemies behind walls, for 8 sec. Use it on base defense to check for approaching stealthers.
pvpTalents: Sigil Mastery, picked by 18 of the top 26 Solo Shuffle players, further reduces sigil cooldowns by 25%. Lay In Wait, picked by 15 of 27 Battleground Blitz and 11 of 26 Solo Shuffle players, turns Sigil of Misery into a 2-charge trap that waits for 90 sec. Illidan's Grasp, picked by 14 of 27 Battleground Blitz players, stuns the target for 5 sec and throws it within 20 yds.
